latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix receiving multiple photos from iOS Photos by @motixo in https://github.com/t4t5/owly/pull/111
* Specify client certificates and link shares, and fix two transfer bugs by @t4t5 in https://github.com/t4t5/owly/pull/113
* Specify upload, timeout and BLE details seen from an iPhone by @t4t5 in https://github.com/t4t5/owly/pull/114
* Let owly-airdrop's tests build and run on Windows by @chaaruze in https://github.com/t4t5/owly/pull/108
* List AWDL peers in owly browse, as owly send finds them by @LeandroLP23 in https://github.com/t4t5/owly/pull/118
* Record the Realtek RTL8812BU working in exclusive mode by @plusky in https://github.com/t4t5/owly/pull/115

## New Contributors
* @motixo made their first contribution in https://github.com/t4t5/owly/pull/111
* @chaaruze made their first contribution in https://github.com/t4t5/owly/pull/108
* @LeandroLP23 made their first contribution in https://github.com/t4t5/owly/pull/118

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/t4t5/owly/compare/v0.4.2...v0.4.3
